purpose: Extend the focused repeated-source stigmergy scaling study to test swarm sizes up to 30 agents.
notes: This bundle is a standalone focused extension rather than a federated broad-plus-killer full bundle.
Primary paired significance tests were run at 6 and 30 agents with 50 seeds each.
Supporting sizes 1, 3, 10, 15, and 20 used 20 seeds each.
